name: Relay
purpose: A ChatGPT-style chat application where signed-in users start conversations, send messages, and see AI replies stream back through a provider adapter.

workflows.name: Sign in
workflows.description: User authenticates via email/password (or OAuth where configured) and lands on their conversations.

workflows.name: Start a conversation
workflows.description: User creates a new conversation and is taken to it.

workflows.name: Send a message and stream a reply
workflows.description: User posts a message; the AI provider adapter streams back a reply token by token.

workflows.name: View history
workflows.description: User sees past conversations with their message transcripts.

seed_demo: One demo user with a sample conversation containing a couple of user/assistant messages so the UI shows real content immediately.
